recipes.title: Levantine Greek Yogurt, Olive Oil & Ground Sumac Toast
recipes.summary: Classic Middle Eastern morning toast spread thick with creamy Greek yogurt or labneh, sweet cherry tomatoes, extra-virgin olive oil, and ruby tangy ground sumac.

ingredient_details.item: thick plain Greek yogurt or labneh

steps: Toast whole-grain bread until crisp and spread thick with creamy Greek yogurt or labneh.
Arrange halved sweet cherry tomatoes and thin cucumber coins on top.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and shower with bright crimson ground sumac.
tips: Ground sumac tastes delightfully bright and lemony with zero heat—an instant Mediterranean flavor lift.
High in morning protein and ready in 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Olive Oil Scrambled Eggs with Ruby Ground Sumac
recipes.summary: Tender low-heat scrambled eggs with wilted baby spinach and olive oil, plated warm and brightened with tangy crimson ground sumac and parsley.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and wilt baby spinach 45 seconds.
Pour in lightly beaten eggs and fold gently 2 to 3 minutes until soft creamy curds form.
Slide onto a warm plate and dust generously with tangy ruby ground sumac and fresh parsley.
tips: Sprinkling sumac at the table keeps its ruby berry color vivid and its lemony sparkle bright.
Replaces extra salt effortlessly.

recipes.title: Creamy Avocado, Lemon & Ground Sumac Whole-Grain Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast topped with velvety smashed avocado, toasted sesame seeds, olive oil, and generous tangy crimson ground sumac.
steps: Mash ripe avocado with half the ground sumac and a tiny pinch of salt.
Spread thick onto warm toasted whole-grain bread.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, toasted sesame seeds, and the remaining crimson sumac.
tips: Sumac's natural tart berry acidity works just like fresh lemon juice to brighten buttery avocado.
Zero cooking and 100% plant-based.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Sweet Berries, Honey & Ground Sumac Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt layered with juicy strawberries and blueberries, toasted rolled oats, honey, and tart citrusy ground sumac.
steps: Spoon cool plain Greek yogurt into a bowl and layer with sliced strawberries, blueberries, and toasted oats.
Drizzle lightly with honey.
Dust crimson ground sumac right across the sweet berries and enjoy.
tips: Because sumac is itself a ground dried berry, it makes strawberries and blueberries taste extra lively and bright.
Packed with polyphenols and morning protein.

recipes.title: Levantine Warm White Bean, Olive Oil & Sumac Morning Bowl
recipes.summary: Inspired by Middle Eastern ful breakfast bowls: creamy warmed cannellini beans lightly mashed with garlic, olive oil, diced tomato, parsley, and ground sumac.
steps: Warm cannellini beans with 3 tbsp water and grated garlic in a saucepan 4 minutes, then mash half gently with a fork.
Spoon creamy beans into two shallow bowls and top with finely diced tomato and chopped parsley.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and scatter crimson ground sumac across the surface.
tips: Warm, velvety, plant-based, and high in steady morning fiber.
Delicious scooped with warm pita or whole-grain toast.

recipes.title: Lebanese Fattoush-Style Chickpea, Cucumber & Sumac Salad
recipes.summary: Classic crisp Levantine salad uniting chickpeas, juicy tomatoes, diced cucumber, tender greens, olive oil, lemon, and abundant tart ground sumac.

ingredient_details.item: tender baby spinach or chopped butter lettuce

steps: Whisk extra-virgin olive oil, fresh lemon juice, 1 tsp ground sumac, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Toss tender greens, rinsed chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and cucumber gently with the ruby dressing.
Dust with the remaining 1/2 tsp crimson sumac and serve fresh.
tips: Ground sumac is the signature lemony sparkle of Lebanese fattoush salad.
Using baby spinach or butter lettuce keeps chewing effortless and soft.

recipes.title: Creamy Hummus, Sweet Roasted Carrots & Ground Sumac Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelized olive-oil roasted carrots piled warm over velvety hummus and cooked quinoa, showered generously with tart crimson ground sumac.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss carrots with 1 tbsp olive oil and half the sumac on a parchment-lined pan and roast 18 minutes until sweet and tender.
Swoosh hummus across two shallow bowls and arrange warm quinoa beside it.
Pile roasted carrots over top and finish with remaining olive oil, fresh parsley, and remaining bright crimson sumac.
tips: Tangy sumac cuts through sweet roasted carrots and creamy hummus beautifully.
100% plant-based and rich in fiber.

recipes.title: Velvety Red Lentil, Tomato & Ground Sumac Soup
recipes.summary: Soothing smooth Middle Eastern red lentil soup brightened richly with crimson ground sumac, sweet onion, olive oil, and fresh lemon.
steps: Soften onion in olive oil 4 minutes, then add crushed tomatoes, rinsed red lentils, vegetable broth, and 1 tsp ground sumac.
Simmer 15 minutes until red lentils melt creamy and soft, then blend silky smooth.
Stir in lemon juice, ladle warm into bowls, and scatter remaining ruby sumac over each serving.
tips: Bright, velvety, and effortless to swallow.
Completely plant-based and reheats smoothly.

recipes.title: Levantine Sumac Poached Chicken & Cucumber Yogurt Wrap
recipes.summary: Tender shredded poached chicken tossed in extra-virgin olive oil and crimson ground sumac, rolled with cool Greek yogurt, cucumber, and spinach inside warm wraps.
steps: Toss shredded poached chicken with extra-virgin olive oil and 1 tsp ground sumac until ruby-tinted and fragrant.
Spread plain Greek yogurt across both soft whole-wheat tortillas and dust with remaining 1/2 tsp sumac.
Layer baby spinach, diced cucumber, and sumac chicken down the center, roll tightly, and halve.
tips: Zero cooking required when using pre-poached chicken.
Refreshing lemony flavor without making wraps soggy.

recipes.title: Steamed Beet, Feta, Walnut & Ground Sumac Salad
recipes.summary: Earthy diced beets, baby spinach, toasted walnuts, and tangy feta brightened with extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, and abundant crimson ground sumac.
steps: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, 1 tsp ground sumac, and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Arrange baby spinach and steamed diced beets in a salad bowl and drizzle with the bright vinaigrette.
Finish with chopped walnuts, crumbled feta, and the remaining 1/2 tsp crimson sumac.
tips: Vacuum-packed steamed beets make this vibrant polyphenol-rich lunch ready in 8 minutes.
Omit feta for a dairy-free plate.

recipes.title: Palestinian Musakhan-Style Sumac Chicken & Sweet Onions
recipes.summary: Beloved Levantine signature dish roasting tender chicken thighs and sweet sliced red onions generously coated in extra-virgin olive oil and crimson ground sumac.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss thinly sliced red onion and chicken thighs with olive oil, minced garlic, and 1 1/2 tbsp ground sumac on a parchment-lined pan.
Roast 22 to 25 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and onions turn jammy, sweet, and ruby-crimson.
Finish with lemon juice, fresh parsley, and remaining 1/2 tbsp sumac; serve over warm flatbread or fluffy rice with cool plain yogurt.
tips: Musakhan is Palestine's national celebratory dish—recreated here in 35 minutes on one sheet pan with zero frying.
Roasted onions soak up tangy sumac and sweeten into silky perfection.

recipes.title: Ruby Ground Sumac, Lemon & Olive Oil Baked Salmon
recipes.summary: Moist baked salmon fillets crusted lightly in bright tangy crimson ground sumac, olive oil, garlic, and lemon beside tender roasted zucchini.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss zucchini with 1 tbsp olive oil and 1/2 tsp sumac on one side of a lined sheet pan.
Set salmon fillets on the other side, brush with remaining olive oil, garlic, and 1 tsp ground sumac, and bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky.
Finish both salmon and zucchini with fresh lemon juice and remaining bright crimson sumac.
tips: Tangy sumac cuts cleanly through rich omega-3 salmon like Meyer lemon zest.
Serve with warm quinoa or rice.

recipes.title: Sumac-Roasted Cauliflower, Chickpeas & Lemon Yogurt Bowl
recipes.summary: Caramelized cauliflower florets and chickpeas roasted in olive oil, cumin, and crimson ground sumac, served warm over lemony Greek yogurt.
steps: Heat oven to 425 F; toss small cauliflower florets and chickpeas with olive oil, cumin, and 1 1/2 tsp sumac on a lined pan and roast 20 minutes until golden and tender.
Stir Greek yogurt with lemon juice and swoop across shallow warm dinner bowls.
Pile hot sumac-roasted cauliflower and chickpeas over the cool yogurt and dust with remaining crimson sumac.
tips: Swap Greek yogurt for plain hummus for a 100% dairy-free plant-based supper.
Bright, satisfying, and packed with fiber.

recipes.title: Tender Turkish Ground Sumac & Parsley Turkey Meatballs
recipes.summary: Moist baked lean turkey kofta meatballs seasoned with crimson ground sumac, fresh parsley, grated onion, and garlic over fluffy rice.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; mix ground turkey, quick oats, egg, parsley, minced garlic, 1 1/2 tsp ground sumac, and a pinch of salt gently into 12 soft meatballs.
Bake on a parchment-lined sheet 15 to 16 minutes until 165 F and tender.
Serve warm over rice alongside cool cucumber-yogurt sauce dusted with remaining ruby sumac.
tips: Quick oats keep lean ground turkey meatballs remarkably soft and moist.
Great for meal prep—reheat in 45 seconds.

recipes.title: Baked Mediterranean Eggplant, Tomato & Ground Sumac Stew
recipes.summary: Meltingly soft diced eggplant and cannellini beans baked with burst cherry tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and fragrant crimson ground sumac.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; toss peeled diced eggplant, cherry tomatoes, cannellini beans, sliced garlic, olive oil, and 1 1/2 tsp sumac in a baking dish.
Cover loosely with foil and bake 20 to 22 minutes until eggplant is spoon-soft and tomatoes burst.
Uncover, scatter fresh parsley and remaining crimson sumac on top, and ladle over warm couscous or polenta.
tips: Covering while baking turns eggplant custard-soft without excess oil.
Plant-based, rich in polyphenols, and gentle to chew.

recipes.title: Ruby Raspberry, Greek Yogurt & Ground Sumac Smoothie
recipes.summary: Lively pink antioxidant smoothie uniting frozen raspberries, plain Greek yogurt, milk, banana, honey, and tart citrusy ground sumac.
steps: Combine milk, Greek yogurt, frozen raspberries, banana, honey, and 1/2 tsp ground sumac in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until vivid magenta and velvety smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Sumac is naturally lemony-tart like pink lemonade berries, making raspberry smoothies burst with freshness.
High-protein and rich in berry polyphenols.

recipes.title: Pink Lemonade-Style Strawberry, Oat & Sumac Smoothie
recipes.summary: Dairy-free breakfast smoothie blending sweet frozen strawberries, rolled oats, oat milk, banana, and tangy crimson ground sumac.
steps: Add oat milk, rolled oats, frozen strawberries, banana, and 1/2 tsp ground sumac to a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until silky rosy pink.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sumac gives sweet strawberry-oat smoothies bright pink-lemonade zing with zero added sugar.
Dairy-free, nut-free, and sustaining.

recipes.title: Wild Blueberry, Kefir & Ground Sumac Polyphenol Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep violet probiotic glass pairing plain kefir, wild frozen blueberries, ripe banana, honey, and antioxidant-rich ground sumac.
steps: Place plain kefir, frozen blueberries, ripe banana, honey, and 1/2 tsp ground sumac in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until deep violet and velvety smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Sumac berries rank among the highest-polyphenol culinary spices—combining effortlessly with dark blueberries and cultured kefir.
Quick and refreshing any time of day.

recipes.title: Sweet Mango, Almond Milk & Tart Ground Sumac Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunny tropical blend balancing lush frozen mango and creamy almond milk with bright citrus-berry ground sumac and vanilla.
steps: Combine almond milk, frozen mango chunks, banana, vanilla, and 1/2 tsp ground sumac in a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until creamy coral-gold and silky.
Serve cold immediately.
tips: Tart sumac cuts right through rich sweet mango just like fresh lime juice.
100% plant-based and caffeine-free.

recipes.title: Dark Cherry, Baby Spinach & Ground Sumac Smoothie
recipes.summary: Deep ruby-purple smoothie hiding a full cup of tender baby spinach inside sweet dark cherries, oat milk, banana, and tangy ground sumac.
steps: Blend oat milk and baby spinach 20 seconds until completely smooth.
Add frozen dark cherries, banana, and 1/2 tsp ground sumac.
Blend 35 seconds more until deep berry-ruby and velvety.
tips: Bright berry sumac lifts dark cherries so you taste pure fruit with a hidden full serving of greens.
Dairy-free and nut-free.

recipes.title: Chilled Ruby Sumac-Ade (Ground Sumac & Honey Citrus Press)
recipes.summary: Traditional tangy pink-lemonade-style herbal press steeping ruby ground sumac in warm water, straining crystal smooth, and chilling with honey and lemon.

ingredient_details.note: 1/2 cup warm for steeping plus 1 1/2 cups chilled

steps: Steep ground sumac in 1/2 cup warm water 6 minutes until vivid ruby-pink, then strain through a coffee filter or very fine mesh sieve.
Dissolve honey into the ruby concentrate, then stir in chilled water and fresh lemon juice.
Pour over tall glasses of ice and enjoy crisp.
tips: Sumac-ade has been cherished across North America and the Levant for centuries as a natural tangy berry lemonade.
Filtering through a paper coffee filter leaves a crystal-clear jewel-pink drink.

recipes.title: Chilled Watermelon, Mint & Ground Sumac Cooler
recipes.summary: Hydrating summer watermelon juice pulsed briefly with tart ground sumac and spearmint, strained silky smooth over ice.
steps: Blend seedless watermelon cubes, ground sumac, lime juice, and spearmint leaves 20 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses.
Sip cold right away.
tips: Tart crimson sumac transforms sweet watermelon into a sparkling crisp summer refresher with zero sugar added.
Wonderfully hydrating on hot afternoons.

recipes.title: Levantine Pomegranate & Steeped Sumac Sparkling Press
recipes.summary: Jewel-crimson polyphenol spritzer pairing 100% pomegranate juice, clear strained sumac infusion, honey, and chilled sparkling water.
steps: Steep ground sumac in 1/4 cup warm water 5 minutes, strain cleanly through a fine filter, and dissolve honey.
Pour the ruby sumac concentrate and 100% pomegranate juice over ice cubes.
Top with chilled sparkling water, stir lightly, and enjoy crisp.
tips: Unites two iconic Middle Eastern ruby antioxidants in one celebratory alcohol-free glass.
Swap sparkling water for still chilled water if preferred.

recipes.title: Sweet Orange & Ruby Ground Sumac Sunrise Press
recipes.summary: Bright sunrise-layered citrus press pouring sweet freshly squeezed orange juice over ice topped with a strained crimson sumac infusion.
steps: Steep ground sumac in 1/3 cup warm water 5 minutes, then strain through a coffee filter until ruby clear.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes and pour in freshly squeezed sweet orange juice.
Float the ruby sumac infusion gently over top and stir right before sipping.
tips: Sweet orange juice balances tart sumac naturally with zero added sweetener.
Stunning golden-to-crimson layered look in a clear glass.

recipes.title: Crisp Apple, Hibiscus & Ruby Sumac Berry Cooler
recipes.summary: Vibrant crimson orchard cooler steeping hibiscus and ground sumac together, strained clean and blended with naturally sweet pressed apple juice over ice.

ingredient_details.item: dried hibiscus petals (or 1 hibiscus tea bag)

steps: Steep hibiscus and ground sumac in 1 cup hot water covered 6 minutes, then strain cleanly through a fine filter.
Stir in naturally sweet pressed apple juice.
Pour over tall glasses of ice and enjoy crisp and caffeine-free.
tips: Pressed apple juice sweetens tart hibiscus and sumac naturally with zero added sugar.
Rich ruby color and brisk berry flavor.
